bug_summary: Mux.Findがネストしたルート(サブルーター)の場合にパターン文字列を正しく合成できず、誤った/空のパターンを返していた
pr_title: Simplify Mux.Find control flow for subroute lookups
pr_description: Flatten the branching in `Mux.Find` so subroute lookups delegate directly to `node.subroutes.Find` instead of concatenating the parent pattern with the subroute result. The old string-trimming/concatenation step was redundant once the subrouter already returns a fully qualified pattern. This also drops the now-unreachable early return for the non-subroute case, collapsing it into a single trailing check.
